name: production boundary: an off-branch push split by backslash-underscore in env's double-quoted -S string is denied unread

source.assertion:
assert_equals "an off-branch push split by backslash-underscore in env's double-quoted -S string is denied unread" \
  "deny" "$(verdict_for 'env -S "git\_push\_origin\_main"')"

contains: past what the production boundary can read
